findings.problem: The last ~30 lines of the proof do real mathematical work, and they are repeated almost verbatim in the sibling files. The argument has four parts. (1) A radial lift g lies in the ball of radius min R S, because r₀·exp(-4B·H x) ≤ r₀ ≤ min R S. (2) The lift g is upper triangular, because the gap hypothesis `Real.log 4 ≤ ell j - ell i` forces the entries below the diagonal to vanish. (3) The root word is upper triangular with unit diagonal, by `positiveRootGeneratedGroup_pattern` and `Matrix.one_apply_ne`. (4) The uniqueness of triangular lifts gives word s = g, so word s lies in V, and V is the preimage of the cube. In the target the block is `hrad`, `hgR`, `hgS`, `hgtri`, `hu`, `hutri`, `hueq` and the final `exact hVcube ...`. NeutralSubordinateObservation.lean (lines 106-136), CoverFutureObservation.lean (lines 140-170) and BranchingSubordinateObservation.lean (lines 170-200) carry the same block, apart from the `hrcap.trans (min_le_left _ _)` adaptation. The `hord : StrictMono ell` proof (the same `hgap` plus `Real.log_pos` plus `linarith` pattern) is also duplicated in the Cover and Branching files. So the argument is copied four times, and any change to the triangularity or uniqueness API must be made in four places.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to `exists_uniform_triangular_lift_radius`, or in UpperRootGlobalCoordinates. Its statement would be roughly: for `d`, `ell` with `hgap`, `R S : ℝ`, `V : Set (G (d+1))` with `matrixBall (d+1) S ⊆ V`, `hunique` exactly as produced by `exists_uniform_triangular_lift_radius d`, `x` with `hx : ∀ v ∈ pointLattice x, v ≠ 0 → ∀ j, v j ≠ 0`, `s : UpperRootTime (d+1)`, and `g ∈ matrixBall (d+1) (min R S)` with `(∀ i j, ell j < ell i → g.val i j = 0)` and `rightAction x g = rightAction x ((completeRootChain (d+1)).word s)`, the conclusion is `(completeRootChain (d+1)).word s ∈ V`. The proof is the current `hgR`/`hgS`/`hgtri`/`hutri`/`hueq` sequence, with `hgap` supplying `hgtri`. A companion lemma `hgap_strictMono : StrictMono ell` can cover the Cover and Branching `hord` blocks. A second small lemma, `r₀ * exp (-(4*B)*H x) ≤ r₀` for `B > 0` and `r₀ ≤ 1`, would remove the repeated `nlinarith`-based `hrad` step. The target's tail then becomes `filter_upwards [ae_no_coordinate_zero d μ hA] with x hx s hs; obtain ⟨g,hg,hgx,hgt,_⟩ := htri Q (fun x y hxy => (hsmall x y hxy).2) x _ hs; exact hVcube (word_mem_of_small_triangular_lift ell hgap hSV hunique hx s (matrixBall_mono (radial_le hrcap …) hg) hgt hgx.symm)`. The other three files make the same call, with their own `hrcap` adaptation. The shared setup that builds `hV`, `S` and `hSV` from `hcube` could be factored as well.
findings.benefit: Four ~30-line copies of one nontrivial argument become one proved lemma and four short calls. The mathematical content (radial smallness, triangularity from the gap, uniqueness of triangular lifts) is then stated once and documented once. A reader of each observation theorem sees only the construction of H and Q, not the matrix-pattern bookkeeping. Maintenance is cheaper, because a change to `hunique`, `matrixBall` or the word-pattern API touches one place.
